detailed_description:
The target video is a realistic vertical e-commerce livestream-product style with warm golden indoor lighting, soft shallow depth of field, and a cozy home-study setting with dark wood paneled walls, illuminated display shelves with decorative objects, and a green leafy plant on the left side.
[Shot 1] A medium close-up frames <Subject 1> from the waist up, centered in the frame, smiling warmly directly at the camera. Her sleek black hair is pulled back in a low ponytail, and she wears the champagne ivory satin spaghetti-strap slip dress with the silver heart pendant necklace. Both hands come up from below the frame and hold <Subject 2>, the pair of glossy black pointed-toe stiletto pumps, by the shoe openings, lifting them to chest level to display the pointed toes and smooth leather uppers toward the lens. Her lips part naturally on each spoken syllable, jaw opening and closing in sync with the driving audio, and she says in an enthusiastic young female sales tone, <d>[Chinese]姐妹们看过来！这双黑色真皮高跟鞋，质感真的绝了。</d> Her right hand gives the left shoe a small upward lift while her mouth stretches into a broad smile showing teeth on the final word, then her lips close briefly.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to an extreme close-up of the black leather insole of <Subject 2>, held by two fingers gripping the shoe opening at the top edge. The camera slowly tilts and drifts along the insole, revealing the fine pebbled leather grain, the embossed brand lettering on the insole footbed, and the neat topstitching along the edge. A fingertip with nude-pink manicure enters from the right and presses gently on the insole surface, flexing the soft leather to demonstrate cushioning. The background is a warm blurred bokeh of orange and green tones. The driving audio continues as a voice-over; <Subject 1> speaks off-screen in the same enthusiastic tone, <d>[Chinese]大家看这个皮面，细腻有光泽，缝线也非常工整；鞋垫软软的，久穿不累脚。</d> The fingertip presses and releases the insole twice in rhythm with the narration.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a low-angle close-up at floor level on a warm honey-colored wooden plank floor. <Subject 1> walks slowly across the frame from right to left, wearing <Subject 2> on both feet, her champagne satin slip dress hem falling to mid-calf. The camera tilts up slightly to follow the legs, showcasing how the pointed-toe pump lengthens the leg line. She then bends down into a crouch, and both hands reach toward the back of the right shoe at the heel, fingers adjusting the collar to demonstrate the soft fit around the ankle. The driving audio continues as voice-over, <d>[Chinese]上脚超显腿长！而且你们看，皮质非常柔软，走路一点都不磨脚。</d> Her fingers smooth the shoe collar once as the line ends.
[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the shot cuts back to a medium close-up of <Subject 1> facing the camera, same warm home-study background as Shot 1. She breaks into a wide excited smile, her left hand rising with the index finger pointing upward toward the upper right of the frame. Her lips move energetically in syllable-sync with the driving audio, jaw dropping wide on emphatic syllables, corners of the mouth lifting into a bright grin, and she says in an urgent promotional tone, <d>[Chinese]现在下单限时秒杀，左下角购物车，手慢无哦，姐妹们！</d> On-screen red bold text with white outline reading "限时秒杀" appears in the lower-left area, accompanied by a glowing orange circular shopping-cart icon; a small sparkle flash effect appears beside the cart icon. She keeps her left index finger pointed up and gives a slight nod on the final word "姐妹们", her lips closing into a warm smile as the frame holds.
